decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposal represents an unacceptable development of the site that would provide cramped and unsatisfactory living accommodation for future residents through inadequate accommodation with poor outlook, privacy and light and insufficient private usable amenity contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and associated supplementary planning guidance.
2.	The design, scale, layout and siting of the proposed development, including its proximity to the boundaries of adjoining land, would not respect its context and would appear cramped, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development).
3.	By reasons of its design and layout the proposal would also result in harm to neighbours' living conditions through loss of outlook and the creation of an unacceptable sense of enclosure to residents of 1 Speart Lane given the scale of the proposed structure on this boundary; and through loss of privacy and overlooking to residents of 26 Springwell Road contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development).
description: Erection of a detached 2 bedroom house to site.
